description: This module manages a basic AIX mksysb (image) of rootvg.

parameters.name: backup_crypt_files
parameters.description: Backup encrypted files. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: backup_dmapi_fs
parameters.description: Back up DMAPI filesystem files. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: create_map_files
parameters.description: Creates a new MAP files. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: exclude_files
parameters.description: Excludes files using /etc/rootvg.exclude. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: exclude_wpar_files
parameters.description: Excludes WPAR files. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: extended_attrs
parameters.description: Backup extended attributes. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: new_image_data
parameters.description: Creates a new file data. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: software_packing
parameters.description: Exclude files from packing option listed in /etc/exclude_packing.rootvg. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: storage_path
parameters.description: Storage path where the mksysb backup is stored.

parameters.name: use_snapshot
parameters.description: Creates backup using snapshots. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Running a backup image mksysb
  community.general.mksysb:
    name: myserver
    storage_path: /repository/images
    exclude_files: true
    exclude_wpar_files: true

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Return message regarding the action. Returned: always
